title: Angle, not document length
summary: Pick among cosine, Euclidean, Manhattan, and Mahalanobis.

choices.text: Mahalanobis distance. Comparing bag-of-words angles is defined by the inverse covariance of the vocabulary.
Euclidean distance on the raw counts. Two documents on the same topic should look far apart whenever one is much longer.
Manhattan distance on the raw counts. The L1 norm cancels document length.
Cosine similarity. It uses the angle between the count vectors and ignores how long each document is.
